summary: Ran check_citation on the 12 most load-bearing ids (42774067, 42489969, 42616901, 42432192, 42573891, 42429864, 42013553, 42570712, 42773997, 42669151, 39173541, NCT06556706). All returned verified=false; on inspection three are genuine citation errors/mismatches, not just phrasing: (1) 42616901 resolves to "Targeting PKGIα Cys(42) attenuates cardiac dysfunction in HFpEF" — a PKGIα study, NOT a urolithin A study, so the flagship UA-CHF claim (diastolic function/remodeling in animals + human EHT) is attached to the wrong paper; (2) 42774067 resolves to "Domain-specific effects of NAD(+) precursors on fatigue and functional performance: a systematic review and network meta-analysis" — no primary-mitochondrial-disease population and no cognition/QoL endpoints in the verified title, and none of n=1599, SMD 1.02 (95% CI 0.43–1.60), SMD 1.50, SMD 0.56 or the 2026 year exists in the record data (no provenance); (3) 42489969 resolves to a generic "NAD⁺ biology and supplementation" review that does not verify the specific circulating-NAD+ claim. The preclinical CHF citations DO resolve to the named agents but to cardiometabolic/injury models, not CHF per se (42573891 = NMN in diabetic mice myocardial fibrosis; 42429864 = high glucose/high fat-induced cardiomyocyte dysfunction; 42013553 = trimethyltin chloride-induced myocardial injury) — the draft's self-caveat is directionally right but mislabels the models and adds "non-significant" qualifiers that contradict the record's positive coding. 42432192 (UA in HFpEF, ceramide axis) and 42773997 (transcriptomics in human myotubes) are substantively consistent. Remaining issues: n=26 for NCT06556706 has no provenance; "уровня обзора" for 42570712 conflicts with its preclinical coding; and the pipeline-only list is internally inconsistent (summary says 4 human studies, methods list 6 records, while NCT06556706 — a human RCT with no results — is dropped from the summary's count). 10 blocking findings reported; approved=false.

findings.issue: n=1599, SMD 1.02 (95% ДИ 0.43–1.60), SMD 1.50 (NADH), SMD 0.56 (NMN), «высокая доза», and the year 2026 have no provenance in record 42774067 (record contains only direction-level outcome coding, no n, effect sizes, CI, dose, or year); per-precursor attribution (NMN→endurance/QoL, NADH→cognition) is also absent from the record.

Citation 42774067 returned verified=false: fetched title is 'Domain-specific effects of NAD(+) precursors on fatigue and functional performance: a systematic review and network meta-analysis' — it does not describe a primary-mitochondrial-disease population nor cognitive/quality-of-life endpoints. The framing 'наиболее сильный уровень человеческих доказательств при первичных митохондриальных заболеваниях (когнитивные функции, качество жизни)' cannot stand as cited.

Clause «повышение циркулирующих уровней NAD+ … подтверждено сопутствующим обзором (42489969)» — check returned verified=false; fetched title is the generic 'NAD⁺ biology and supplementation: From mechanisms to clinical perspectives', which does not verify a specific claim of precursor-driven circulating NAD+ elevation.

findings.location: Резюме, bullet 2 (and матрица/методы wherever 42616901 is cited for urolithin A)
findings.issue: Critical citation mismatch: 42616901 resolves to 'Targeting PKGIα Cys(42) attenuates cardiac dysfunction in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction' — a PKGIα-targeting study, not a urolithin A study. The claim «уролитин A значимо улучшал диастолическую функцию и ремоделирование у животных и в инженерной сердечной ткани человека» is attached to the wrong paper; all uses of this id for UA (including the «не сравнивался с GDMT» list) are compromised.

For 42432192: (a) «благоприятные, но не значимые эффекты» contradicts the record, which codes all 7 outcomes as positive — the non-significance qualifier has no provenance; (b) «кардиомиоциты, полученные из иПСК человека» appears nowhere in the record. The HFpEF-model framing itself is supported by the fetched title ('…ameliorate cardiac remodeling in HFpEF', gut-ceramide axis matches the record's ceramide outcome).

42573891 resolves to 'Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Ameliorates Myocardial Fibrosis in Diabetic Mice Possibly by Modulating SIRT3 to Deacetylate GSK3β…Smad3' — a diabetic cardiometabolic mouse model, not a CHF model. The summary presents it as CHF evidence and the caveat sentence mislabels it «модель кардиомиоцитарного/сердечно-сосудистого повреждения»; «значимо улучшал» is an unproven strength claim (ROS-level outcome is also absent from the fetched title).

42013553 resolves to 'Trimethyltin chloride triggers ferroptosis in myocardial injury: mitochondria-dependent protection by luteolin' — a toxicant (TMT)-induced injury model, not CHF. Additionally «без статистической значимости» contradicts the record (myocardial injury: positive, ferroptosis: positive; no significance data in record).

«RCT при синдроме хрупкости у пожилых (n=26)» — the sample size n=26 has no provenance in record NCT06556706 (record gives design/population/outcome only). The citation itself verifies well ('Impact of Urolithin A (Mitopure) on Mitochondrial Quality in Muscle of Frail Older Adults').

«данные по болезни Паркинсона — уровня обзора (42570712)» conflicts with the record, which codes 42570712 as preclinical (mitophagy pathway: unclear); the fetched title ('The gut-brain-mitophagy axis: Urolithin A as a transcriptional activator of Parkin in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases') does not confirm it is a review. Align the narrative with the record's coding.

Internal inconsistency in the pipeline-only set: the summary lists 4 human studies (NCT07344636, NCT07782671, NCT07231848, NCT07517913) while Methods lists 6 records (adds NCT06556706 and NCT06941584). NCT06556706 is a human RCT with no published results (already flagged «без результатов» in bullet 3) and is omitted from the summary's count; NCT07517913 is classified as one of the 4 «человеческих исследований» in the summary but as an observational/kinetic record in Methods.
